newsitem.title: USA: United Petroleum sets drilling program.
newsitem.headline: United Petroleum sets drilling program.

text.p: United Petroleum Corp said on Thursday that an agreement in principle had been executed with Kastle Resources of Edinboro, Pa., for a multiwell drilling program in Pennsylvania and Ohio.
The company said in a statement the wells drilled in Ohio would be to an approximate depth of 2,700 feet to Rose Run formation.

The majority of the wells in Pennsylvania will be drilled to an approximate depth of 4,600 feet to the Silurian Medina formation while several of the wells will be drilled deeper to an approximate depth of 7,400 feet to the Rose Run and Warrior formations.
Drilling is anticipated to commence by the end of September and projections are to have drilled 40 wells by the end of 1996.
Kastle will serve as operator and participate for a 25- percent interest in the Pennsylvania wells and a 30-percent interest in the Ohio wells.
The Company further announced that sales of natural gas commenced yesterday from the Company's first well in Pike County, Ky., that was drilled this year.
